card.title: Relief Is Suspicious
card.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our restaurant passed inspection? Even the grease trap?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Spotless. I had it pumped out. Can I start cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the trouble's moved into the tanker. Is it still outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've bottled it under pressure beside our diners. Ask the driver to leave before I unlock the doors.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 doubts inspection success, A3 moves the risk to the tanker and A5 interprets sealing as dangerous pressure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 pumping explains A3 displaced trouble; B4 containment produces A5 pressure fear and a departure demand.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to cook after passing inspection and B4 offers relevant safety reassurance.

heightening.evidence: B4 intended safety fact becomes A5 the reason to keep diners out until the tanker leaves.

specificity.evidence: A1 restaurant inspection, B2 grease removal and A5 doors establish a practical opening decision.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 bottled trouble keeps the threat literal enough to motivate action without a detached joke.
